provenance: Answerable questions were written by reading the crawled pages (crawl of 2026-11-06); gold_urls are the page(s) whose text answers the question and gold_evidence paraphrases or quotes the supporting text. Unanswerable questions are either outside the public HR corpus (out_of_scope), answered only by sites the crawler could not reach (out_of_coverage), or must be refused by policy.
caveat: Visible development set: thresholds, stopwords and policy rules were tuned while these questions were visible. Not a holdout result.

questions.question: How many floating holidays do staff get each fiscal year?
questions.gold_evidence: Each fiscal year ... 2 non-cumulative floating holidays

questions.question: What is a gift day?
questions.gold_evidence: A gift day is a paid day (use of benefit time is not required)

questions.question: Are unused floating holidays paid out at termination?
questions.gold_evidence: Unused floating holidays are not paid out at the time of termination

questions.question: How many days do new employees have to choose health, dental and life insurance coverage?
questions.gold_evidence: You have 30 calendar days from your hire or benefit eligibility date

questions.question: What does the Paid Leave for All Workers Act provide?
questions.gold_evidence: up to 40 hours of paid leave per year to employees who do not currently receive vacation leave

questions.question: How much is the employee referral incentive for hard-to-fill staff positions?
questions.gold_evidence: referral incentive of $600

questions.question: At what rate do civil service employees earn sick leave under the Merit Board benefits policy?
questions.gold_evidence: earn credit for Sick Leave with full pay at the rate of one work day for each month

questions.question: How many hours can an Extra Help employee work before a required break?
questions.gold_evidence: 30-calendar-day break after working 900 hours

questions.question: What happens if an Extra Help appointment reaches 900 hours in less than 12 months?
questions.gold_evidence: may not be eligible for reappointment for up to six months

questions.question: Who is eligible for the Faculty/Staff Emergency Fund?
questions.gold_evidence: At least 6 months of continuous regular employment ... at least a 50%-time basis

questions.question: How do employees apply for emergency funding from the Faculty/Staff Emergency Fund?

questions.question: What counseling services are available to faculty and staff at no cost?
